title: PI Controller Design Using Root-Locus for Enhanced Performance in Rotational System
expert_review: Strong extension of P6.11, challenging students to leverage zero placement for improved dynamic performance. Integrates modeling, root-locus analysis, and robustness considerations effectively.
learning_objectives: Design a PI controller using root-locus techniques
Place controller zero to improve transient response
Achieve desired pole locations without pole-zero cancellation
Ensure robust and stable closed-loop performance
Verify asymptotic tracking and disturbance rejection capabilities
